tours.name: Old Town Heritage Walk
tours.blurb: Private historian-led walk through the colonial quarter.
tours.details: A slow morning through cobbled streets, courtyards and cloisters normally closed to the public, with a historian who reads the city like a text. Ends with café de olla in a private patio.

tours.name: Coffee Finca Morning
tours.blurb: Estate tour and cupping table with the grower.
tours.details: Drive into the highlands to a family estate. Walk the shade-grown terraces, watch the wet mill at work, then sit at a private cupping table to taste this year's micro-lots alongside the grower.

tours.name: Sunrise Volcano Ascent
tours.blurb: Guided pre-dawn climb above the cloud line.
tours.details: A private guide, a warm vehicle and an early start. Moderate ascent on a maintained trail to reach the ridge as the light comes up, with breakfast served at the summit.

tours.name: Artisan Textile Atelier
tours.blurb: Backstrap loom session with a master weaver.
tours.details: A hands-on afternoon in a working atelier. Learn the natural dye process, sit at the loom, and take home the panel you weave. Translation provided throughout.

tours.name: Chef's Table Tasting Menu
tours.blurb: Seven courses at the pass, wine pairing included.
tours.details: The kitchen closes to the public and cooks for your table alone. Seven courses built from that morning's market, paired by the sommelier, served at the pass.

tours.name: Thermal Waters & Spa Afternoon
tours.blurb: Private cabana, mineral pools and a 90-minute treatment.
tours.details: An unhurried afternoon at the mineral springs with a reserved cabana, a ninety-minute treatment for each guest, and the thermal circuit to yourselves before the evening crowd.

tours.name: Market & Mercado Breakfast
tours.blurb: Dawn market walk with a chef, breakfast at the stalls.
tours.details: Arrive with the growers. Walk the aisles with a chef who buys here daily, taste your way through the stalls, and sit down to breakfast cooked from what you chose.

tours.name: Private Transfer
tours.details: Late-model SUV with a licensed English-speaking chauffeur, bottled water and flight tracking. Priced per vehicle, up to four guests with luggage.
